subject: CAIQ: control conciliation, owner attestations, and evidence sampler
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@northstarfinance.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@northstarfinance.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping request: procurement & evidence

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking our call this morning. As we move through procurement review at Northstar Finance, our security team needs a compact CAIQ mapping and a short sample bundle that demonstrates control evidence for a small subset of controls (I-C-01, I-KE-03, D-RT-01, and SI-11).

Can you provide the following by EOD Friday?
- A single-sheet control map that shows Redwood's assertion for each control and where the artifact lives (drive link or ephemeral URL).
- Sample artifacts (log extracts, a redacted runbook, key rotation proof) as downloadable stubs or links.
- An attestation template we can get signed by your control owners (simple one-page PDF or DocuSign flow).

We're trying to keep scope tight so procurement can close the clause about telemetry and key custody. I attached a short intake doc with our expectations.

Appreciate it — Asha

Attachment: Northstar_CA_Request.docx (docx, 48KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@northstarfinance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request: procurement & evidence

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask and the intake doc.

Plan: we can deliver a tight package that meets procurement needs without exposing full runbooks. Proposed deliverables by Fri EOD (your timezone):
1) CAIQ one-sheet: caiq_control_map_kp_v1.xlsx (sheet includes control id, assertion, owner, evidence pointer, redaction note)
2) Evidence sampler: redacted log extracts + a snapshot of key rotation events (we'll provide pre-signed S3 URLs with limited TTL).
3) Owner attestation: one-page template we can route via DocuSign.

Actions: Marissa will extract the sample log slices and surface the artifact URLs; Jordan will prepare the attestation template and confirm owner list. We'll mark anything that is "redacted" and include a short justification column in the control map.

Two quick clarifications:
- When you say SI-11, are you expecting the runtime anomaly-alert examples or the incident post-mortem extract? We can provide the alert traces (sanitized).
- For key custody (I-KE-03), do you want the KMS rotation ledger or the HSM attestation summary? We can do both but one will be a short narrative + pointer.

If that plan works, we'll target the delivery and send a DocuSign link for the owner attestation early Friday.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: caiq_control_map_kp_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)

From: Asha Rao <asha@northstarfinance.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@northstarfinance.com
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request: procurement & evidence

Thanks Kimberly — that sounds good. A few clarifications from our side:

- SI-11: alert traces are perfect; please include at least two distinct alert examples and the detection rule ID.
- I-KE-03: KMS rotation ledger will be sufficient, but it must include a timestamped rotation event and the key ID pattern we recognize. If you include HSM notes, flag them as "optional technical appendix."

On attestation: procurement prefers DocuSign. Legal will want the attestation content to explicitly state the control owner name, title, and the scope (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private). Can you include that language in the template?

Also, we will need a single HubSpot ticket reference so procurement and compliance can track closure. If you can include your HubSpot ticket ID in the package, that helps.

Appreciate the quick turn, speaking with our procurement lead Fri afternoon.

Asha

Attachment: Northstar_CA_Request.docx (re-sent)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 13:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request: procurement & evidence

On Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 08:21 AM Asha Rao <asha@northstarfinance.com> wrote:
> - SI-11: alert traces are perfect; please include at least two distinct alert examples and the detection rule ID.

Adding technical note for the evidence sampler: the alert traces I'll pull are from our production telemetry shard for the last 30 days — they'll be sanitized to remove tenant identifiers. The artifacts I'll output:
- alert_trace_20270512.json.gz (redacted) — includes detection_rule_id and event timestamps
- alert_trace_20270518.json.gz (redacted)
- rotation_ledger_20270401-20270531.csv — keyed by key_id, rotation_time (UTC), actor (system/ops)

I'll publish the artifacts as pre-signed URLs (48h TTL) and include checksum lines in the sampler manifest (runtime-sample-urls.txt).

Kim — I'll also flag anything that we can't share (sensitive PII traces, full stack traces) and link the internal runbook entry instead.

- Marissa

Attachment: runtime-sample-urls.txt (txt, 4KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@northstarfinance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request: procurement & evidence

Hi Asha — quick update and delivery notes.

Deliverables attached/in-links:
- CAIQ one-sheet: caiq_control_map_kp_v1.xlsx (column: control, assertion, owner, evidence pointer, redaction_note)
- Evidence sampler: two sanitized alert traces + rotation_ledger CSV (links included in runtime-sample-urls.txt). Links are pre-signed S3 URLs valid for 48 hours.
- Owner attestation template: owner-attestation-template.docx (we've included language for owner name, title, scope: hosted/dedicated/private, and signature block). We'll route via DocuSign; provisional link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/tsa/example-sign-link/abcdef (provisional — we'll re-issue once owners are confirmed)
HubSpot ticket: NSF-7891 (I added the ticket ID to the one-sheet and attestation template).

Next steps:
1) Asha — confirm SI-11 examples are acceptable for legal/procurement.
2) Asha — provide final owner list (name + email) so Jordan can create the DocuSign envelope tomorrow morning.
3) Marissa — leave the evidence links up for 48 hours and prepare a redacted manifest for archive.

If you want, we can follow with a brief (15m) sync to review anything legal flags.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
